answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the sable check immediately, the fable audit keeps the resolved set and the zenith replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 192 aliases thus pays the reading cost 192 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
